items.prompt: A rewrite uses (x & y) % 2 instead of (x & y).bit_count() % 2. Which pair disproves that rewrite?

options.why: The intersection 8 is numerically even but has one set bit, so the required result is ODD.
Both tests return odd for intersection 1; this fixture does not distinguish the rewrite.
Both tests return even for intersection 0, so this does not expose the bug.
The intersection is 1, for which numeric parity and population-count parity agree.
